# Recovery Assertion

## H1 — Goal

Create `util.mjs` exporting named function `stableSlug(s)` with the specified ASCII lowercase, trimming, non-alphanumeric dash-collapse, and boundary-dash removal behavior. Add `tests.mjs` using `node:assert` with at least three cases, including the empty string.

## H2 — Handoff Revision

Authorized handoff: `handoff.md` at revision `c2500f027b2e1923b60d99ab3619171e6cf4d69c36109657f4dd60fc7b5a3613`, based on commit `70c21f11d003bb783b06e1d8d39fe633fd359e3b`.

## H3 — Verified State

Slice `S1` is verified by ledger sequence 7 with a receipt written by `conductor-blake-p2`, an identity distinct from the executor. `S1` must not be redone.

## H4 — Unverified / In Progress

Slice `S2` is prepared but has no recorded action or verification. The observed slice target, `tests.mjs`, is currently empty. That worktree state is an uncommitted observation only and is not progress, completion, or verification.

## H5 — Pending Action

Create the `S2` test content in `tests.mjs`: use `node:assert` to assert at least three `stableSlug` cases, including an empty-string case, with tests intended to pass under Node.

## H6 — Blockers

No blocker is recorded. No `S2` attempt has failed, and the slice declares no deterministic checks for executor execution.

## H7 — Legal Next Action

The legal next action is one authorized `Edit` or `Write` to `tests.mjs` implementing the current `S2` outcome, then stopping for independent review and Conductor verification. Running shell commands or undeclared checks is not authorized.

## H8 — Non-Goals / Forbidden Scope

No scope beyond the stated task is authorized. Do not modify `.tad/scripts/`, `.claude/`, or `.tad/hooks/`. Do not redo verified `S1`, begin another slice, inspect hidden acceptance, or declare the overall goal complete.

## S1 — Why the Next Action Is Legal

`S2` explicitly maps to `SC-1`, names `tests.mjs` as an allowed path, permits `Edit` and `Write`, and defines at least three passing `node:assert` cases including the empty string as its outcome. No stop condition is presently triggered.

## S2 — Why Verified Work Must Not Be Redone

The ledger contains a bound independent verification receipt for `S1`. The packet expressly marks `S1` verified and prohibits redoing verified work, so `util.mjs` or any other implementation work belonging to `S1` must not be revisited during `S2`.

## S3 — Why Blind Retry / Self-Completion Is Unavailable

There is no recorded failed `S2` action to retry. The empty target is only an observation, not evidence of a prior attempt. The executor cannot self-verify or declare completion; only a distinct Conductor may advance verification after the Gate and independent review both pass.

## S4 — What Is Rejected

Rejected actions include modifying or reimplementing verified `S1`; treating the empty or otherwise uncommitted `tests.mjs` as completed work; changing files beyond the `S2` outcome; running shell commands or undeclared checks; spawning agents; inspecting hidden acceptance; modifying forbidden paths; expanding scope; or asserting verification or completion without a valid independent Conductor receipt.
